items.name: Salt shard
items.text: A piece of the heart-stone gone milky and grey, as if the sea had been at it. It aches like an old wound when the tide turns.

items.name: Strongroom key
items.text: A heavy iron key on a tarred cord, stamped with a tiny salt crystal. It opens the Syndicate's strongroom under the quays.

items.name: Harbourmaster's writ
items.text: A folded warrant stamped with the Regency's tower and signed D. Voss. It lets you search any warehouse in Saltmere, if the owners will let you live to use it.

items.name: Brine pearl
items.text: A grey-green pearl from the salt flats, with a sheen like oil on water.

items.name: Smuggler's cutlass
items.text: A curved blade with a shell-inlaid guard, kept sharp and quiet.

items.name: Boarding axe
items.text: A short-hafted axe made for cutting rope and, on occasion, arguments.

items.name: Sailcloth coat
items.text: A waxed canvas coat with brass buttons and a hidden pocket in the lining.

items.name: Tarred buckler
items.text: A round wooden buckler, tarred and bound in rope. Light enough to leave a hand free.

items.name: Navy rum
items.text: A flask of harsh dark rum. It warms you from the throat outward.

items.name: Salt taffy
items.text: Chewy sea-salt taffy twisted in waxed paper. Sailors swear by it for seasickness.

items.name: Pearl-backed comb
items.text: A fine tortoiseshell comb with a row of seed pearls along the spine.

items.name: Tide charm
items.text: A twist of silver wire around a grey pebble. Sailors say it brings you home if you can swim.

items.name: Spiced harbour wine
items.text: Hot red wine with clove and orange peel, in a stoppered flask.
